I really don’t give a damn whether or not you feel personally attacked. We’re all just sharing anecdotal evidence and treating it like hard facts, remember? And [judging by this 2017 rapport](https://www.ecdc.europa.eu/sites/portal/files/documents/Final_2017_EAAD_ESAC-Net_Summary-edited%20-%20FINALwith%20erratum.pdf) you're not doing too well. Spotting any trends regarding antibiotics use in Europe? This map is literally like every other map regarding any subject in Europe, and I think you know on which side of that chart people rather be on. Tell your countrymen to try an aspirine once in a while, works wonders.

As I’ve said before, not going to argue any further. Cheerio.
